decision_precedence.condition: unresolved_sev1 == 0 and unresolved_sev2 == 0 and substantive_evidence_sufficient == true

amendment_rationale: RBM-004 v1.0.0 initial release. Six gates, each naming a failure mode observed in the domain rather than invented for symmetry with another profile.

chain_gates.name: Filing-observable verification
chain_gates.requirement: Every quantitative claim must be reproducible from a named filing -- accession number, form type and reporting period -- by anyone holding the same document. A figure that cannot be traced to a filing is ALLEGED and can never establish occurrence.
chain_gates.failure_mode: A screener's number is cited as though it were the company's. Vendors apply undisclosed normalisations, and the figure cannot be regenerated by anyone else.

chain_gates.name: Restatement and revision integrity
chain_gates.requirement: Where a period has been filed more than once at different values, every version must be reported with the filing that produced it. No version may be selected silently, and an as-restated figure may never be compared against an as-originally-filed one.
chain_gates.failure_mode: A ratio is computed from an original 10-K and compared to a later year that was restated, so the trend is an artefact of the correction rather than of the business.

chain_gates.name: Share count and dilution
chain_gates.requirement: Basic and diluted counts must be distinguished, the count must be dated, and instruments issuable into shares must be enumerated. A market capitalisation must state which count it used.
chain_gates.failure_mode: Apple's FY2013 share count is filed at 899,213,000, then 899,213, then 6,294,494,000 after a retroactive split -- three answers for one period across a factor of 7,000, each equally confident.

chain_gates.name: Control and related parties
chain_gates.requirement: Identify every holder of disproportionate voting power, every class of share and its rights, and material related-party transactions. A claim of dispersed ownership must be verified against the filings that report control.
chain_gates.failure_mode: A company is described as widely held while a founder retains supervoting shares that decide every vote.

chain_gates.name: Exit liquidity
chain_gates.requirement: Liquidity must be assessed as the cost of exiting a stated position size, not as average daily volume. Borrow availability and cost are identified separately where a short is contemplated.
chain_gates.failure_mode: Average daily volume is reported as though it were depth. The question a holder faces is what leaving costs, and ADV does not answer it.

chain_gates.name: Reproducibility
chain_gates.requirement: Every figure must carry the filing, period and retrieval that produced it, and a sample must be re-retrieved and shown to reproduce. A figure that cannot be regenerated is a claim.
chain_gates.failure_mode: A number is quoted from memory or from an earlier draft, and nobody can tell which filing it came from.
